senses.gloss:
नेद् नेद्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To blame (cf. निद्).
 2. † To be near.
नेदिष्ठ नेदिष्ठ, superl. (from नेद for नद्ध, ptcple. of the pf. pass. of नह्; cf. Goth. nehva; A.S. neah), Very near, nearest.
नेदीयंस् नेदीयंस्, comparat. of the last (q. cf.), Nearer, as near as possible, Rājat. 4, 31.
